title: macrotyloma stenophyllum
intro: Macrotyloma stenophyllum, commonly known as Horse Gram, is a legume plant native to tropical Africa and Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help manage diabetes, lower cholesterol levels, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Horse Gram include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating cardiovascular diseases, improving digestion, and enhancing immune function. The bioactive constituents of Horse Gram include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties.
